paper_metadata.title: A 1.8-GHz CMOS Fractional-N Frequency Synthesizer With Randomized Multiphase VCO
paper_metadata.abstract: A 1.8-GHZ fractionalfrequency synthesizer implemented in 0.6m CMOS with an on-chip multiphase voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO) exhibits no spurs resulting from phase interpolation. The proposed architecture randomly selects output phases of a multiphase VCO for fractional frequency division to eliminate spurious tones. Measured phase noise at 1.715 GHz is lower than 80 dBc/Hz within a 20-kHz loop bandwidth and 118 dBc/Hz at 1-MHz offset with no fractional spurs above 70 dBc/Hz. The synthesizer has a frequency resolution step smaller than 10 Hz. The chip consumes 52 mW at 3.3 V and occupies 3.7 mm 2.9 mm.
